messages:
maria: Heads-up — staging keystore-proxy QPS spiked ~4x around 09:10 UTC, KMS grpc 503s, blocking GPU warmup jobs. Filing INF-1329 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1329
alex: Copy, can you paste the proxy logs or metrics?
taylor: metric snapshot: `keystore_proxy.request_rate` jumped from 320/s -> 1300/s, 95p latency from 80ms -> 420ms.
ken: Sounds like the proxy rate-limiter is tripping, but firewall egress to KMS also shows bursts. Could be both.
maria: Log snippet: ```
E 09:11:03 keystore-proxy request_id=abc123 upstream_error: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
E 09:11:04 keystore-proxy rate_limiter drop=1 capacity=100 curr=1250
```
alex: @oncall-l3 can you confirm if we have any recent KMS quota changes or network ACL edits?
oncall-l3: No quota changes on KMS. There was a subnet NACL tighten at 08:50 UTC for staging (PR #4821) but it was scoped to telemetry. Investigating if it touched privatelink routes.
taylor: If NACL is aggressive we might see retransmits -> retries -> amplification. Short-term fix: bump keystore-proxy replicas and add a conservative allowlist for privatelink IPs. Longer fix: tune proxy token bucket.
ken: Plan A: 1) add 2 replicas to keystore-proxy deployment 2) temporarily add allowlist CIDR for staging privatelink to firewall for 2 hours 3) reduce proxy burst window to 50 -> monitor 4) roll back firewall after stabilization.
ops-bot: deploybot: rollout started for keystore-proxy +2 replicas (deploy/keystore-proxy #202)
alex: Cost note — adding firewall allowlist for KMS endpoints will increase audit log egress and might bump S3 ingestion, estimate ~$30/day while active.
maria: OK with cost. prefer 2h window and strict monitoring. I'll run the rollback script if errors >1% for 20m.
oncall-l3: I'll watch warmup queue and KMS error rate. If no improvement in 12m, we'll flip to plan B (proxy connection pooling + throttle).
taylor: Envoy rate-limit tweak we'll try for Plan B: ```yaml
rate_limits:
  - stage: inbound
    unit: minute
    requests_per_unit: 3600
```
ken: After we stabilize, follow-up: add synthetic warmup tensor jobs to test keystore scaling before next deploy, and add an alert for keystore_proxy.request_rate > 800/s for 5m.
maria: Sounds good. tagging INF-1329 with remediation steps. :thumbsup: :face_with_monocle:
alex: Thanks all — keeping thread here for postmortem notes.
